record: C3 Stage-4 fresh confirmation — frozen cells
freezes: the cells the C3 prereg deferred: 'Required replication: >=2/3 policies (exact cells frozen with Stage 4)'
ordering_evidence: no rollout has been run on seed block 9810000+; Stage 4 is not yet implemented in the runner at freeze time

scope.latent_birth_additionally_requires: the Environment-Demand Gate (payoff matrix, preference reversal, LCB95(G_available) > 0, competence floor, behavioral nonredundancy)

seeds.why_both_legs: Observational-only confirmation on fresh seeds would allow the counterfactual result to remain overfitted to discovery states.

leg_1_fresh_natural.name: onset prevalence replication
leg_1_fresh_natural.quantity: carrier-pressure anchors per episode on the fresh block
leg_1_fresh_natural.floor_derivation: 0.5 x the discovery rate — the phenomenon must still occur at at least half its discovery frequency
leg_1_fresh_natural.floor_rationale: A replication bar that is neither trivially passable nor a demand for exact equality. Fixed as a multiple of an already-published number so it cannot be tuned to the fresh data.
leg_1_fresh_natural.statistic: episode-clustered bootstrap over episodes, 2000 resamples, seed 12345

leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.name: fork rate replication
leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.type: counterfactual — the frozen commitment-fork screen, rerun

sampling.design: stratified, 10 anchors per policy x opponent stratum, 210 total
sampling.frame: the COMPLETE fresh Stage-1 census on 9810000+
sampling.why_a_distinct_seed: Stage 4 draws from a different anchor population; reusing the Stage-3 seed would carry no benefit and invites confusion between the two draws.
sampling.low_count_fallback: identical to the Stage-3 amendment: cap at available, redistribute the deficit round-robin by (policy_seed, opponent)

leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.estimator: per policy: p_hat_policy = sum over that policy's strata of (N_h / N_policy) * p_hat_h
leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.why_per_policy: The frozen replication requirement is >=2/3 POLICIES, so the statistic must be computed per policy rather than pooled as in Stage 3.
leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.statistic: episode-clustered bootstrap within policy, 2000 resamples, seed 12345
leg_2_fresh_counterfactual.per_policy_pass: LCB95(weighted fork rate for that policy) > 0.20

replication_rule.a_policy_confirms_iff: leg 1 PASS AND leg 2 PASS for that policy
replication_rule.note: Both legs are required per policy. A policy passing only one leg does not count toward the replication total.

verdicts.STAGE4_FAIL: O3 not authorized. Do not adjust the floor, the threshold, the seed block or the leg definitions; all were frozen before any Stage-4 data existed.

immutability: After any Stage-4 rollout produces data, none of the above may change: seed block, episodes per cell, the 2.5079 natural floor, the 0.20 fork-rate threshold, the sampling design or seed derivation, the per-policy estimator, the bootstrap procedure, or the >=2/3 replication rule.
